text:
megan: Quick debrief from the onboarding lab — users hit messy error shapes across SDKs. This makes the sample app kludgey and confuses product UIs.
ryan: Agreed. They can't tell if a 401 means "refresh token" vs "contact support". We should give both a short human message and a machine action.
sara: Idea: two parallel signals on errors: `human_action` (short hint) and `machine_action` (enum). Keep machine_action tiny: reauth, backoff, escalate, noop. UI uses human_action, infra uses machine_action.
leo: Also add `error_id` (short string) for correlate logs + support tickets. Example: error_id: "auth.invalid_token" or "rate.quota_exceeded:bucket_free". Helps filtering without parsing messages.
megan: Proposal for SDK surface (flat, language-friendly):
- name/type (string)
- status (number)
- code (enum like "invalid_token", "quota_exceeded")
- machine_action (enum)
- human_action (short string)
- retryable (bool)
- retry_after_ms (nullable int)
- error_id (string)
Keep it small so mapping is easy in all languages.
ryan: Small ergonomic asks per language:
- JS: Error subclasses with properties and a .isRetryable() helper.
- Go: an interface with methods Status() int, Code() string, RetryAfter() *time.Duration.
- Py: exception attributes and a to_dict() helper for logging.
sara: Streaming gotcha: streams sometimes return 200 with an embedded error payload. Clients must inspect and raise the same typed error. We should document the exact body shape we expect for streaming errors.
leo: Server side will normalize Retry-After to ms in `X-RW-Retry-Ms` for critical endpoints; clients should parse standard Retry-After too but prefer the explicit header when present.
megan: Example TS snippet to illustrate shape:
```ts
class RateLimitError extends Error {
  status = 429
  code = 'rate_limit'
  machine_action = 'backoff'
  human_action = 'wait and retry or reduce request rate'
  retryable = true
  retry_after_ms = 30000
  error_id = 'rate.limit:global'
}
```
ryan: For 401 mapping: if OAuth body contains error="invalid_token" or error_description -> code=invalid_token, machine_action=reauth, retryable=true, human_action="prompt user to re-authenticate". If body has reason=revoked -> code=revoked_token, machine_action=escalate, retryable=false.
sara: Telemetry: require SDKs to emit code + error_id as tags in logs/metrics. That lets infra dashboards and alerts filter without heuristics.
leo: Backwards compatibility: SDKs should implement a compatibility shim that maps legacy shapes to the new contract for two releases. Add a debug flag `RW_ERROR_STRICT=true` to opt-in early.
megan: Test plan: cross-SDK harness with vectors: Retry-After (seconds), Retry-After (http-date), X-RW-Retry-Ms, body-embedded error, streaming-frame error, oauth invalid_token, oauth revoked_user. Add sample-app A/B test showing UI with human_action CTAs vs plain messages.
infra-bot: Infra note: proxies may rewrite Retry-After, so X-RW-Retry-Ms will be added for quota endpoints next sprint.
docs-bot: Docs issue created: "Error ergonomics: human_action + machine_action + error_id" assigned to @megan, due in 6 days.
ryan: One more: prefer short human_action strings (<=80 chars) to avoid UI overflow. Also prefer machine_action enum stable names.
sara: I'll start a PR with the mapping table + language snippets and include the test vectors. Please add corner cases you want covered.
megan: Thanks — I'll add the sample-app changes and metrics collection for the A/B. Small wins here should reduce support tickets and improve onboarding completion. :+1:
